grade_basis: Repository source and readiness metadata are extensive, but this run cannot make an outcome-blind candidate selection because forbidden outcome fields were displayed before freeze. The team therefore evaluates mechanism coherence and blockers only and does not project a candidate.

subject.name: 2026-08-18 cross-surface Alpha readiness
subject.research_question: Does any generated mechanism have both a coherent transmission and an honestly complete admission contract in this run?

business_analyst.conclusion: All three mechanisms have plausible economic transmissions, but none should be tested until its fixed falsifier and readiness bars are met.
findings: Exit lifecycle maps timestamped advisory severity into reduce-risk, hold, or no-action decisions and must prove scarce-slot replacement value against cash and the existing exit helper.
Flow-options disagreement can proxy constrained hedging or delayed equity-flow response, but one-sided flow or option state is too noisy and the paired source contract is incomplete.
News Hawkes can represent delayed second-order information propagation, but beta, peer proximity, and entity-map reuse remain live alternative explanations.
falsifiers: Exit: hard-stop/advisory subtype bars and 5/5/5 standard-window touches must pass before any replacement-value test.
Flow-options: at least 20 settled paired disagreements, a passing source/use contract, and concentration/touch bars are required.
News Hawkes: at least 38 independent group-date decisions across 18 dates, max group share at most 40 percent, and a bound transmission/touch artifact are required.

financial_analyst.conclusion: Cash and no additional exposure are the only executable opportunity-cost choice; current incremental capital capacity is zero because portfolio control is fail-closed.

evidence.claim: Broker NAV is USD 60,020.2314 with USD 13,474.38 cash, 18 open positions, and one observation.
All 19 control rows are blocked and ok_to_add_control_pass is false because 38 manual bracket instructions are not broker-confirmed.
The latest warehouse close independently matches all 19 economic position rows closely enough for exposure reconciliation, but does not grant candidate admission.

execution_constraints.unresolved_cost_contract: The proposal must uniquely define whether the 35 bp round-trip cost includes or is additional to per-leg slippage; no candidate may rely on an ambiguous or double-counted stack.

industry_researcher.conclusion: The three mechanisms use distinguishable market structures, but their current evidence components do not provide the independent, licensed, historical-PIT transmission needed for admission.
findings: Exit lifecycle is internally derived from held-position and price context, so it is not independent of the OHLCV prior; the missing action-to-fill-to-slot/cash mapping is load-bearing.

Moomoo flow and onclickmedia options differ from the price prior and from each other, but historical vintages, use authorization, and the complete option term structure are not proven. Global-stock-data classifies CBOE as C-grade requiring prior approval and therefore it was not substituted as canonical evidence.

News Hawkes is independent of the price prior, but Google News/secondary-media inputs are C-grade or unclassified; only SEC inputs are S-grade, and the current SIC/entity mapping is not historical-PIT.

risk_assessor.conclusion: This run cannot honestly satisfy the outcome-blind card contract, and no clean-room reset is authorized inside the same run. PIT, component registration, novelty, reopen, touch density, owner authority, and current exposure control provide additional independent blockers.

lead_synthesis.rationale: Mechanism plausibility does not cure a contaminated selection scope or missing machine contracts. Changing the card to outcome_blind=true, editing the frozen surface binding, fabricating touches, or treating a partial source contract as pass would evade the repository protocol.
lead_synthesis.next_action: Begin the next automation run from a fresh scope with no candidate outcome exposure, then recheck the quantified exit, flow-options, and Hawkes conditions before selecting one candidate.

ai_research_limitations: The team deliberately did not use historical winner status, adapter maturity, candidate returns, or Gate outcomes to rank mechanisms.
Source labels such as official, S, B, or C describe access/compliance and do not establish canonical PIT or predictive value.
